basic_info.description: Located just half a block from vibrant Polk Street, this well-maintained duplex offers a rare opportunity in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. Both units are set to convert to individual condominiums at close of escrow, providing flexibility for homeowners and investors alike. The upper residence is a spacious two-level, 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit with a great natural flow between living spaces. The living room features a wood-burning fireplace and expansive city views. The penthouse-level primary suite includes an en-suite bathroom and a generous walk-in closet, offering privacy and comfort. From this upper level, enjoy a subtle yet striking view of the Golden Gate Bridge an elegant reminder of the city's iconic landscape. The lower unit is a private 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home with charming outlooks over the beautifully landscaped yard. Each unit includes dedicated parking, and the garage offers additional space with potential for development into expanded living or work areas. At the rear of the property, a deep backyard with mature trees and a deck provides a peaceful outdoor retreat rarely found in this part of the city. This is a unique opportunity to own and shape a property in a prime location, steps from shops, dining, and neighborhood charm.
